priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup function
findings.body: Calling the returned teardown no longer unregisters `handler`. If the socket remains alive, stale handlers continue processing messages and remain retained; repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate listeners, causing duplicate work, memory growth, and eventual listener-limit warnings.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: The current full diff for src/socket.ts changes the cleanup returned by attach from socket.off("message", handler) to an empty function at RIGHT line 3, so teardown still leaves the registered handler attached.
